name: Missouri
overview: Missouri DNR issues air permits statewide (EPA's Missouri page lists no local permitting agencies and no federally recognized tribes). Construction permits under 10 CSR 10-6.060 are chosen by existing and project potential emissions: de minimis, minor, general, permits-by-rule, portable relocation, temporary/pilot, major NSR (nonattainment), PSD, and major HAP permits. Exemptions are in 10 CSR 10-6.061. Operating permits under 10 CSR 10-6.065 are Intermediate (synthetic minor) or Part 70.

permitTypes.name: Construction permit exemptions
permitTypes.description: Activities determined to be insignificant sources are exempt from construction permitting.

permitTypes.name: Permits-by-Rule
permitTypes.description: For printing, crematories and animal incinerators, surface coating, and livestock markets, in place of a de minimis or minor permit; can be issued within seven days of a complete application.

permitTypes.name: De minimis and minor construction permits
permitTypes.description: For projects below major thresholds. Minor permit filing fee $300 plus $100/hour processing. Portable relocation and temporary/pilot permits also available.

permitTypes.name: Major NSR (nonattainment)
permitTypes.description: Major construction permit for nonattainment areas; $6,000 filing fee. EPA reclassified the Missouri portion of the St. Louis area to Serious for the 2015 ozone standard, but the Eighth Circuit stayed that rule on June 6, 2025, so Moderate requirements remain while the stay is in effect.

permitTypes.name: PSD
permitTypes.description: Major construction permit for attainment areas; $6,000 filing fee plus processing. PAL permits available.

permitTypes.name: Intermediate Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: For installations accepting federally enforceable limits to stay below major source levels; five-year term; apply within 90 days after operation begins.

permitTypes.name: Part 70 Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: For installations at or above major source levels; five-year term; apply within 12 months after operation begins; renew 6 to 18 months before expiration.

oilAndGas.summary: DNR's construction and operating permit pages list no oil-and-gas-specific air permit.
